summary: Amer Sports, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its press release announcing second-quarter 2026 financial results. Revenue rose 32% to $1,633 million, with all segments growing double digits; adjusted operating profit increased 209%. The company raised full-year guidance. This is a routine earnings disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change. The filing is informational only, and no deal terms or strategic actions are described, so no special-situation category applies.
